description_en: Queries the list of organization members including seat information. Supports filtering by name, status, and seat assignment, and supports pagination
description_zh: 查询组织成员列表（含席位信息），支持按名称、状态、是否分配席位过滤，支持分页
kebab_example: aliyun modelstudio list-organization-members --name '成员名称' --status ACTIVE --has-seat true --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOrganizationMembers

parameters.help_en: Fuzzy filter by member name. Matches accountName or email and is case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh: 成员名称模糊过滤（匹配 accountName 或 email，忽略大小写）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: Filters by member status, such as ACTIVE or FROZEN. Set to null to disable filtering
parameters.help_zh: 成员状态过滤（如 ACTIVE、FROZEN），null 表示不过滤
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to filter by seat assignment
parameters.name: has_seat

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.name: page_size
